validation.command: pnpm --filter frontend exec vitest run src/i18n scripts/catalogImport.test.ts
validation.placeholders_and_tags: No mismatches after excluding deliberate <wbr/> hints.
validation.context_comments: Every public catalog entry has context.
validation.japanese_plural_resolution: All 25 omitted _one groups select Japanese _other for counts 0, 1, 2, and 10.
validation.literal_jsx_sweep: No prose in JSXText nodes in non-test frontend TSX files; other text factories reviewed separately.

limits: This is an editorial and implementation-based audit, not a native-speaker usability study.
All public catalog rows assessed individually; developer strings read separately and intentionally English.
Representative live browser inspection: English and Japanese board/settings, Japanese Explore empty search, Shop and checkout. Failure branches assessed from code, not all triggered live.

Kyoto Seika subject data is Japanese-source vocabulary, not an English-to-Japanese UI translation catalog. Provenance/structure and samples reviewed; every subject/reading was not individually linguistically validated.
Third-party diagnostics, proper names, original license notices, and intentional Japanese animation lettering are not blanket translation defects.
Proposed copy is review material, not an import-ready patch. Context findings can require behavior, layout, or approved vocabulary decisions.
Japanese public Terms/Privacy are deliberate placeholders with different content from English; they cannot be called fully translated policy pages.
